<!--
Read CONTRIBUTING.md before opening a PR. Review time is limited, and meeting the
requirements does not guarantee review or merging. Solve one underlying problem.
The same requirements apply to drafts.
Use a conventional commit title in plain language, such as "fix(sync): archived threads no longer reappear after reconnect".
-->

## Problem

<!-- Explain the problem in a sentence or two. Include expected behavior and
reproduction steps or platform where relevant. -->

## Change

<!-- Explain how this fixes the problem. If it spans Rust and the frontend,
explain why both are needed for the same fix. Split independent fixes. -->

## Scope and approval

<!-- Link the triaged bug issue, or the discussion comment where the maintainer
explicitly approved the direction and scope. For a very small, focused fix of an
obvious bug, explain why it qualifies without a prior issue or discussion. For a
focused option on an existing capability, explain what exists, what the option
controls and why its effects stay within that capability. -->

## Verification

<!-- Describe the focused tests or manual checks you ran, on which platform
(macOS, Windows, Linux), and what you observed. State anything you could not
check. "Tests pass" alone is not enough.

For UI changes, include clear before/after screenshots, and a short recording
when motion, timing or interaction matters. Upload evidence to GitHub and embed
or link it here; never commit PR-only assets. Redact real addresses, message
content and tokens. -->

<!-- If you used an agent, end with the model and harness that did the work. -->
